document_metadata.title: 1、INT. MOVIE THEATRE - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Young Carl witnesses Muntz's public disgrace after scientists expose his fabricated monster skeleton, but remains inspired as Muntz vows to return to Paradise Falls and capture the beast alive.

entities.name: Young Carl becomes enthralled by Muntz's adventure footage
entities.description: Eight-year-old Carl Fredricksen watches newsreel footage of explorer Muntz with intense fascination in a small town theater, captivated by the depiction of aerial adventure and canine companionship.

entities.name: Muntz descends the gangplank to public acclaim
entities.description: Explorer Muntz exits his airship by walking down the gangplank, greeted by an enthusiastic crowd and flashing cameras, accompanied by his dogs.

entities.name: Muntz delivers his 'Adventure is out there' slogan
entities.description: Muntz strikes his signature 'thumbs up' pose and declares 'Adventure is out there!' to the crowd, inspiring young Carl in the theater to mimic the gesture.

entities.name: Dogs undergo mechanized care on Muntz's airship
entities.description: One of Muntz's dogs endures a mechanized bath while another wears an electrode helmet and runs on a treadmill, demonstrating the airship's canine-focused amenities.

entities.name: Newsreel Screening At Small Town Theater
entities.description: A public screening of a newsreel featuring explorer Muntz and his airship takes place in a modest small-town theater, drawing audience attention and inspiring young Carl Fredricksen.
entities.summary: A public screening of a newsreel featuring explorer Muntz and his airship takes place in a modest small-town theater, drawing audience attention and inspiring young Carl Fredricksen.

entities.name: small town theater
entities.description: A modest theater in a small town where the newsreel screening takes place and where young Carl watches Muntz's adventure footage.

entities.name: 8 year old
entities.description: Indicates Carl Fredricksen's age at the time of the newsreel screening, anchoring the temporal context of his childhood experience.

entities.name: Carl Fredricksen
entities.description: An 8-year-old boy who is deeply inspired by Muntz's adventures and watches the newsreel with awe, emulating his idol by wearing a flight helmet and giving a thumbs up.
entities.summary: An elderly man, emotionally attached to his late wife Ellie and their home, lives in isolation in a floating house, resists relocation to Shady Oaks, and forms a bond with young Russell amid storms and shared moments.

entities.name: Charles Muntz
entities.description: A celebrated adventurer who returns from an expedition on his airship, greeted by public acclaim and known for his slogan "Adventure is out there!".
entities.summary: A charismatic, eccentric explorer and owner of the 'Spirit of Adventure' airship, known for his slogan 'Adventure is out there!', hosts Carl and Russell after initial confrontation, reveals a collection of smuggled artifacts and helmets from intruders, and demonstrates both hospitality and territorial control near Paradise Falls.

entities.name: Newsreel Announcer
entities.description: An off-screen voice providing commentary during the newsreel screening, describing Muntz's airship and public reception.

entities.name: leather flight helmet and goggles
entities.description: A set of aviator gear worn by young Carl Fredricksen, modeled after his idol Muntz, symbolizing his admiration and aspiration for adventure.

entities.name: Airship
entities.description: A large, luxurious lighter-than-air craft designed by Muntz for exploration and canine comfort, featuring amenities like a mechanical dog walker and doggie bath.
entities.summary: A large, luxurious lighter-than-air craft designed by Muntz for exploration and canine comfort, featuring amenities like a mechanical dog walker and doggie bath.

entities.name: electrode helmet
entities.description: A device worn by one of Muntz's dogs during mechanized care on the airship, part of the automated system for canine maintenance.

entities.name: treadmill
entities.description: A mechanical running device used on Muntz's airship to exercise his dogs as part of their automated care routine.

entities.name: canine comfort
entities.description: A design principle behind Muntz's airship, emphasizing luxury and automated care for his dogs during flight.

entities.name: Muntz reveals the Monster of Paradise Falls skeleton to the audience
entities.description: Muntz unveils a giant bird skeleton on stage in front of a crowded auditorium, presenting it as the Monster of Paradise Falls.

entities.name: Scientists质疑 the authenticity of the skeleton
entities.description: Skeptical scientists examine the bones and declare them to be a fabrication, leading to public controversy.

entities.name: National Explorers Society strips Muntz of membership
entities.description: The organization removes Muntz's portrait from the wall and rips his badge from his jacket, formally expelling him due to the scandal.

entities.name: Muntz vows to return to Paradise Falls and capture the beast alive
entities.description: Standing beside his airship at an airfield, Muntz publicly declares his intention to return to Paradise Falls and capture the living creature to prove his claim.

entities.name: Muntz departs in his dirigible amid public cheers
entities.description: Muntz gives a thumbs up from the cockpit as his airship lifts off, beginning his journey back to Paradise Falls while the crowd applauds.

entities.name: crowded auditorium
entities.description: An indoor venue filled with people where Muntz presents the Monster of Paradise Falls skeleton on stage.

entities.name: airfield
entities.description: A ground area where Muntz's dirigible is stationed and from which it departs.

entities.name: cockpit
entities.description: The control compartment of Muntz's dirigible where he gives a thumbs up before takeoff.

entities.description: An 8-year-old boy who is deeply inspired by Muntz's adventures and emotionally invested in the story of the Monster of Paradise Falls.
entities.summary: An 8-year-old boy who is deeply inspired by Muntz's adventures and emotionally invested in the story of the Monster of Paradise Falls.

document_metadata.summary: Carl distracts Dug with a thrown tennis ball and the bird with chocolate, then grabs Russell and runs away while Dug and the bird chase the distractions.

entities.name: Bird drags Dug while clamped onto its leg

entities.description: Russell physically tries to pull Dug off the bird, inadvertently tugging on Carl's tether.

entities.description: Carl expresses frustration that their argument is preventing them from reaching their destination on time.

entities.name: Carl pulls tether and knocks Russell over
entities.description: In an attempt to regain control, Carl yanks the tether, causing Russell to fall.

entities.name: Dug
entities.description: A talking dog who is eager to capture the bird and pledge loyalty to Carl, whom he calls 'master'.
entities.summary: A talkative, loyal dog with a high-tech collar is on a special mission to track a bird, occasionally distracted but committed to his master Carl, and is noted by others as a potential challenger to Alpha's leadership.

entities.name: Russell
entities.description: A young boy traveling with Carl who tries to mediate conflicts and maintain progress toward their destination.
entities.summary: An 8-year-old Wilderness Explorer boy persistently helps Carl Fredricksen on a journey, seeking to earn his Assisting the Elderly badge while navigating challenges like storms and communication difficulties.

entities.name: Carl
entities.description: An elderly man on a journey to the falls, resistant to companionship and frustrated by delays caused by Dug and the bird.
entities.summary: A young boy shares imaginative adventures with Ellie, from childhood encounters and playful exploration to joining her explorer club, bonding over secrets, and eventually marrying her at 19 in a formal ceremony.

entities.name: Kevin
entities.description: A large, colorful bird that resists Dug's attempts to capture it and defends itself aggressively.
entities.summary: A large, colorful, flightless bird named by Russell exhibits playful, intelligent, and mimicking behavior, resists Dug's capture, defends itself aggressively, and helps Carl and Russell cross a chasm before being attacked by Alpha.

entities.description: A rope or strap connecting Russell to Carl, used to keep Russell from wandering off; its tension causes physical disruptions during conflicts.

entities.name: House
entities.description: Carl's floating house, lifted by balloons, which crashes into a tall rock after Carl falls.
entities.summary: Carl's house, lifted by balloons, serves as a flying vehicle and shelter for Carl and Russell on their journey to Paradise Falls, fulfilling a dream he shared with Ellie.

document_metadata.title: 114、INT. DIRIGIBLE, DINING ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Muntz insists Carl and Russell stay, but after seeing the bird on the roof and hearing a wail, he orders his dogs to get them as they flee.

entities.name: Muntz leads Carl and Russell to the dining table
entities.description: Muntz guides Carl and Russell into the dining room and escorts them to a large table where they are about to have a meal.

entities.name: Dog waiters pull out chairs and assist guests
entities.description: Dogs trained as waiters pull back chairs for Carl, Russell, and Muntz, allowing them to sit down at the dining table.

entities.name: Dog waiters place napkins on guests' laps
entities.description: After seating, the dog waiters place napkins on the laps of Carl, Russell, and Muntz as part of formal dining service.

entities.name: Dogs unveil covered plates simultaneously
entities.description: The dog waiters bring out covered dishes, exchange glances, and dramatically remove the silver covers from the plates at the same time.

entities.name: Russell's hot dog is partially eaten by a waiter
entities.description: After Russell is served a hot dog, the attending dog waiter cannot resist and takes a bite from it.

entities.name: Another dog waiter drinks from Russell's juice glass
entities.description: A dog waiter pours juice for Russell but then takes a large slurp from the same glass.

entities.name: Carl expresses admiration and shares memory of Ellie
entities.description: Carl looks around in awe and tells Muntz that his late wife Ellie would have loved the experience, linking her dream to Paradise Falls.

entities.name: Muntz expresses honor and welcomes the guests
entities.description: Muntz responds to Carl by saying he is honored and confirms that their visit is a genuine pleasure, not an imposition.

entities.name: Dogs react excitedly to the word 'treat'
entities.description: Upon hearing Muntz say 'treat,' the dogs erupt into loud barking and clamor for snacks, disrupting the dinner atmosphere.

entities.name: A dog steals the remainder of Russell's hot dog
entities.description: In the chaos following the word 'treat,' one of the dogs grabs and eats the rest of Russell's hot dog.

entities.name: Muntz reprimands the dogs and corrects his word choice
entities.description: Muntz scolds the dogs to calm down and acknowledges that using the word 'treat' was a mistake that triggered their behavior.

entities.name: Muntz reveals history of unwanted intruders
entities.description: Muntz tells Carl and Russell that while they are welcome, he usually receives thieves trying to steal what he considers his rightful property.

entities.name: Muntz picks up a lantern and moves to the back of the room
entities.description: After the dinner interaction, Muntz takes a lantern and walks toward the rear of the dining room, signaling a shift in the scene.

entities.name: Dinner With Muntz
entities.description: A formal dining event hosted by Muntz for Carl and Russell, featuring elaborate service by trained dogs and conversation about their journey and past.
entities.summary: A formal dining event hosted by Muntz for Carl and Russell, featuring elaborate service by trained dogs and conversation about their journey and past.

entities.name: dining room
entities.description: An interior room where Muntz hosts Carl and Russell for dinner, featuring a large table and attended by dog waiters.

entities.name: porthole window
entities.description: A window in the dining room through which Carl's house is visible, tethered outside.

entities.name: Paradise Falls
entities.description: A named landmark referenced as Ellie's dream destination, associated with the setting of the current scene.
entities.summary: A fictional South American waterfall and landmark symbolizing Carl and Ellie's unfulfilled dream, referenced in a mural, painting, and engraving as a distant, elusive destination.

entities.name: Charles Muntz
entities.description: A man who lives near Paradise Falls and hosts Carl and Russell for dinner, revealing a history of defending his territory from intruders.
entities.summary: A charismatic, eccentric explorer and owner of the 'Spirit of Adventure' airship, known for his slogan 'Adventure is out there!', hosts Carl and Russell after initial confrontation, reveals a collection of smuggled artifacts and helmets from intruders, and demonstrates both hospitality and territorial control near Paradise Falls.

entities.name: Carl
entities.description: A guest at dinner who expresses admiration for Muntz and shares a personal memory about Ellie and their dream to live by Paradise Falls.
entities.summary: A young boy shares imaginative adventures with Ellie, from childhood encounters and playful exploration to joining her explorer club, bonding over secrets, and eventually marrying her at 19 in a formal ceremony.

entities.name: Russell
entities.description: A young boy dining with Carl and Muntz who is served a hot dog and repeatedly reacts to dogs stealing his food and drink.
entities.summary: An 8-year-old Wilderness Explorer boy persistently helps Carl Fredricksen on a journey, seeking to earn his Assisting the Elderly badge while navigating challenges like storms and communication difficulties.

entities.name: Epsilon
entities.description: The chef referred to by Muntz as the finest he has ever had, responsible for preparing the meal served to the guests.
entities.summary:
The chef referred to by Muntz as the finest he has ever had, responsible for preparing the meal served to the guests.
One of Muntz's dogs, specifically noted as making a delicious Cherries Jubilee, indicating a role in serving or preparing food.

entities.name: dog waiters
entities.description: Canine assistants who serve guests at the dining table by pulling out chairs, placing napkins, and delivering food and drinks.

entities.name: covered plates
entities.description: Silver-covered dishes brought by the dog waiters and unveiled simultaneously to reveal the prepared meals.

entities.name: hot dog
entities.description: A food item served to Russell that is partially eaten by a waiter and later fully stolen by another dog during dinner.

entities.name: juice glass
entities.description: A glass of juice served to Russell from which a dog waiter takes a drink.

entities.name: napkins
entities.description: Cloth napkins placed on the laps of guests by the dog waiters during the meal service.

entities.name: lantern
entities.description: A portable light source picked up by Muntz as he moves to the back of the dining room.

entities.name: unwanted intruders
entities.description: Individuals referred to by Muntz as thieves who come to steal what he considers rightfully his, contrasting with welcomed guests.

entities.name: House
entities.description: Carl's floating house, visible through the porthole window, which he and Ellie dreamed of bringing to Paradise Falls.
entities.summary: Carl's house, lifted by balloons, serves as a flying vehicle and shelter for Carl and Russell on their journey to Paradise Falls, fulfilling a dream he shared with Ellie.

entities.name: Ellie
entities.description: Carl's late companion whose dream was to move to Paradise Falls and live there, inspiring Carl's journey.
entities.summary: A spirited red-haired girl imagines adventures as a dirigible pilot, bonds with Carl by sharing her Adventure Book, cheers him, marries him, paints with him, and later appears as a zookeeper amused by his antics.

entities.name: Muntz reveals his obsession with the bird Kevin
entities.description: Muntz explains his lifelong pursuit of the bird, showing photographs, drawings, feathers, and a full-size skeleton to Carl and Russell, expressing his determination to clear his name by capturing it.

entities.name: Muntz expresses disbelief at Russell's claim of taming Kevin
entities.description: Upon hearing Russell call the creature 'Kevin' and claim it as a pet, Muntz reacts with shock and skepticism, questioning how it could be possible for the bird to follow them.

entities.name: Russell reveals Kevin's attraction to chocolate
entities.description: Russell explains that he trained the bird by giving it chocolate and demonstrates by holding up a chocolate bar, indicating that Kevin is strongly drawn to it.

entities.name: Carl confiscates Russell's chocolate bar
entities.description: Fearing the consequences of revealing Kevin's location, Carl quickly takes the chocolate bar from Russell and pockets it to prevent further discussion or demonstration.

entities.name: Muntz becomes intrigued and moves toward flight helmets
entities.description: After learning about Kevin's fondness for chocolate, Muntz falls silent, then walks thoughtfully toward a table filled with flight gear, suggesting a new plan forming in his mind.

entities.name: deathly labyrinth
entities.description: A dangerous, maze-like area where the bird Kevin lives, described as inescapable once entered.

entities.name: mountain
entities.description: The general physical setting referred to by Muntz as a dangerous place guarding his domain and the bird’s habitat.

entities.name: Alpha
entities.description: A dog who exchanges a glance with Muntz during Russell's claim about taming Kevin, indicating a position of recognition or authority among the dog waiters.
entities.summary: A Doberman pinscher serving Muntz enforces rules on the dirigible, speaks in a high-pitched voice, leads tracking efforts, and holds authority among the dogs, reacting to threats and commands.

entities.name: flight helmets
entities.description: Helmets located on a table that Muntz moves toward after learning of Kevin's attraction to chocolate, suggesting intent to pursue aerial travel or exploration.

entities.name: skeleton
entities.description: A full-size skeleton observed by Russell and Muntz, resembling the bird Kevin and serving as a physical representation of Muntz's long-term pursuit.

entities.name: photographs
entities.description: Visual records of the bird Kevin illuminated by the lantern, part of Muntz's collection documenting his lifelong obsession.

entities.name: drawings
entities.description: Illustrations of the bird Kevin, part of Muntz's extensive collection gathered over years of tracking the creature.

entities.name: samples
entities.description: Collected specimens related to the bird Kevin, including feathers and other materials, stored by Muntz as evidence of his research.

entities.name: feathers
entities.description: Physical remnants of the bird Kevin, preserved by Muntz as part of his collection proving the creature's existence.

entities.name: Muntz'S Obsession
entities.description: The driving intellectual and emotional fixation of Muntz centered on proving the existence of the bird Kevin and restoring his reputation.

document_metadata.summary: Kevin is injured by a dog bite and cannot stand; Russell tends to her while the bird babies call from afar. Carl reluctantly agrees to help get her home despite the risks.
